goal.task: Add a minimal hello-counter capability to the existing hello_world backend
goal.behavior: accepts a single word; returns the word together with a running per-word count
goal.state_scope: per-word counters must survive repeated invocations within the same runtime process; nothing is required across separate program runs
goal.test_required: include a minimal verification test exercising the counter
goal.integration_required: route it through the existing ARPAPED Bridge (sample/hello_world/backend/runtime/bridge) without modifying the Bridge's architecture

decisions.reason: No existing registered capability provides per-word counting (Phase 3 discovery over the generated capability catalog: zero candidates under counter/*).
